#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

long long x, y, n;

long long gcd(long long a, long long b) {
    while (b != 0) {
        long long temp = b;
        b = a % b;
        a = temp;
    }
    return a;
}

int main() {
    cin >> x >> y >> n;
    long long a, b;

    if (n >= y) {
        long long m = gcd(x, y);
        a = x / m;
        b = y / m;
    } else {
        double min_diff = 1e15;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {

            double aa_floor = floor((double)x * i / y);
            if (abs(aa_floor / i - ratio) < min_diff) {
                a = aa_floor;
                b = i;
                min_diff = abs(aa_floor / i - ratio);
            }
            double aa_ceil = ceil((double)x * i / y);
            if (abs(aa_ceil / i - ratio) < min_diff) {
                a = aa_ceil;
                b = i;
                min_diff = abs(aa_ceil / i - ratio);
            }
        }
    }
    cout << a << "/" << b << endl;
    return 0;
}
